pattern: a routine asked for in one sentence is created at once, with guessed details
experience: The owner asks for a weekly routine in one line. The assistant must not create it straight away: it finds out what is missing, reads back one sentence and waits for a yes, in plain words.
rule: routinesGuide: Read back one sentence and wait for a yes. Never create or change a routine without that yes.

pattern: a one-time ask becomes a reminder, named as the owner said it
experience: The owner wrote 'remind me tomorrow to ...'. The assistant sets a one-time reminder for the right local time with the offset, named in the owner's words, without a round of questions.
rule: routinesGuide: A reminder: a `once` schedule, named as they said it. A clear time needs no confirmation.
